hero.title: AI-Aware Full Stack Engineer
hero.subtitle: Building full-stack products and applied ML systems.
hero.description: I build full-stack products with React, Next.js, Node.js and React Native, while researching machine learning and NLP with Python, BERTurk and explainable AI. Currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering and building ReHeal, a digital health startup.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a Computer Engineer focused on full-stack product development and applied machine learning. I work across TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, React Native and Python, with current research in BERTurk, NLP and explainable AI. I am pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering at Trakya University and building ReHeal, a digital health startup.

projects.title: ReHeal Digital Health Platform
projects.description: A digital health product with a React Native patient app and a Next.js clinic platform. Includes QR onboarding, lab report OCR, medication adherence, patient health trends, RBAC, PostgreSQL RLS and Supabase Auth, Realtime and Storage.

projects.title: Pharmaguard AI — SUT & Prescription Compliance
projects.description: AI-powered healthcare compliance web app analyzing Healthcare Implementation Directive (SUT) regulations and medical reports using Gemini LLM models with batch PDF processing.

projects.title: Algoviz — Interactive CS & AI Playground
projects.description: An interactive educational platform simulating 23 core concepts across computer science, distributed systems (Raft, LRU Cache), and modern AI/ML (Self-Attention, CNN, Decision Trees). Features 3D WebGL loss landscapes powered by Three.js.

projects.title: DropSpot — Smart Locker & Delivery Network
projects.description: End-to-end delivery and smart locker management system built with Next.js 16, Express microservices, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, dynamic priority scoring engine, and full-stack Docker containerization.

projects.title: Turkish Crisis XAI Verification
projects.description: A BERTurk-based binary classifier for Turkish crisis tweets with hybrid NER/Regex location extraction and explainability analysis. Evaluated on 11,268 samples with 5-fold cross-validation, reaching 92.26% ± 0.81 F1.

projects.title: AI-Powered Career Recommendation System
projects.description: A machine learning recommendation engine using Kariyer.net data, NLP, TF-IDF and KNN. Built with Python, BeautifulSoup and Django as a graduation project in a 6-person team.

projects.title: Browser Video Crunch
projects.description: A serverless video compression tool that processes 4K video entirely in the browser (client-side) using WebAssembly. Features real-time performance metrics and resolution scaling.

projects.title: Fast Apply Extension
projects.description: A productivity extension designed to speed up job applications by 50%. Features a dynamic context menu manager for inserting custom text snippets instantly.

projects.title: AI Resume Analyst
projects.description: A machine learning system that parses resumes and matches them with real-time job listings using NLP (TF-IDF, Cosine Similarity).

projects.title: Node.js Production Boilerplate
projects.description: Enterprise-level backend starter kit featuring layered architecture, advanced security (Helmet, Rate Limiting), and automated Swagger documentation.

projects.title: Campfire Social
projects.description: A scalable micro-blogging platform backend built with Flask and MongoDB. Features include JWT authentication, nested comment structures using MongoDB's document model, and a smart voting system with aggregation pipelines for performance.

projects.title: E-Commerce Dashboard
projects.description: A comprehensive admin panel for managing products and analytics. Built with React, TypeScript and modern UI principles.

experience.description: Building a digital health startup across a React Native patient app, a Next.js clinic platform, and PharmaGuard AI. Working with Expo, Supabase, PostgreSQL RLS, Gemini Vision, and TypeScript rule engines.
Volunteer contributor and mentor for university projects. Helped migrate cPanel/MySQL systems to Supabase PostgreSQL with RLS and supported the team with Git and Agile practices.
Worked on production React and Next.js applications, including Digiroom. Contributed to SSR, dynamic routing, Supabase RLS, Firebase Cloud Functions, and e-commerce and booking synchronization.
Designed a micro-blogging platform using Vue.js and Flask. Managed CI/CD pipelines.
Built an internal notification center using React.js and Redux. Led a team of 3 interns.
Migrated the company’s website from WordPress to React.js. Contributed to a React Native mobile application for local kids' events.

education.description: Relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Text Mining, Cognitive Technologies, Scientific Ethics. Projects include a BERTurk crisis-tweet classifier with hybrid NER/Regex location extraction (11,268 samples; 95.75% accuracy), a CrowdStrike/Microsoft crisis analysis, and an ADS-B flight anomaly detector using Isolation Forest, SHAP, FastAPI and Next.js.
Graduation Project: AI-Powered Career Recommendation System, built with Kariyer.net scraping, TF-IDF, KNN and Django in a 6-person team.
